paras: Upgrade your Nissan or Infiniti's front braking performance with Dixcel brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel brake rotor types shown for vehicles fitted with the Akebono front caliper and 355x32mm front rotors , including the Nissan 370Z (Z34) and 370Z Nismo , Nissan Z (RZ34) , Nissan Skyline 200GT-t/370GT (V36/V37) , Nissan Fuga (Y51) , Infiniti G37 (V36) , Infiniti FX 30d/37/50 (S51) , Infiniti M 30d/37 (Y51) , Infiniti Q50/Q60 (V37) including Red Sport and Hybrid variants, Infiniti Q70 (Y51) , and Infiniti QX70 (S51) .
